player_prompt.intro:
Yu bilong Pleeya {player_id} long Wild Tic Tac Toe.
Long turn bilong yu, yu ken putim 'X' o 'O' long skwea we i khali.
Yu winim taim yu alainim tri bilong sem mark (X o O) long lain.
Yu ken winim wantaim eni simbol.
Chusim muv bilong yu usim fomat '[X 4]' long putim X long senta.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fomat bilong muv i rong. Usim '[X 4]' o '[O 2]' fomat.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Namba bilong sel i no stret: {cell}. Em mas stap namel long 0 na 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: I no orait long mekim dispela wok. Sel {cell} i stap pinis.

game_action.placed: Pleeya {player_id} putim simbol bilong em ({mark}) long sel {cell}
